summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.16-rc0): ## What's Changed * openai: forward truncation option in responses requests by @marlonferreira1800-hue in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19501 * openai: return an empty array for /v1/models when no models are installed by @liangliang205 in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19539 * llama.cpp: version bump b12177 by @dhiltgen in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19576 * README: add Quock to Mobile community integrations by @matteocelani in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19361 * windows: add CUDA 13.5 and SM 103 for ARM64 by @dhiltgen in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19580 * MLX: make Qwen3.8 Flash Next memory efficient by @dhiltgen in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/18078 * launch: fix Claude Code routing and retired model errors by @hoyyeva in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19587 * Add ripple preview support to the MLX runner by @pdevine in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19592 ## New Contributors * @marlonferreira1800-hue made their firs
